[page 1]
  Commissioning / Model Verification Procedure CP-23

 Revision C - 2026-03-03

 1. Objective
 Verify the released room CO2 feedback-control configuration over the approved 24-hour weekday occupancy
  profile using effective parameters current after CR-IAQ-007.
 2. Preconditions
 Room volume = 100 m3.
 Nominal air density = 1.2 kg/m3.
 Outdoor CO2 = 300 ppm = 0.3*1.519E-3 kg/kg.
 Occupant CO2 generation = 8.18E-6 kg/s/person.
  Controller: Kp=6.0 ACH/normalized, bias=3.5 ACH, integral disabled, limits 0.2..6.0 ACH.
 Use OCC-SCH-04 Rev C.
 3. Test steps
  1. Initialize room concentration to the outdoor concentration and start at 00:00 with zero occupants.
  2. Execute the occupancy schedule continuously through 24:00. Treat each schedule interval as piecewise constant.
  3. Compute room trace concentration using the well-mixed zone balance. Evaluate controller at an internal integration
 step no larger than 1 s.
  4. Log at 60 s intervals: time, occupant count, room ppm, room kg/kg, normalized feedback, ACH command, source
 mass-flow command, physical supply mass flow, people carrier flow, and actual CO2 generation.
  5. Report the maximum room CO2 and its time. Confirm the result is not greater than 1000 ppm.
  6. Confirm source command sign and physical flow sign are opposite for the outdoor-air source.
  7. Confirm one-person people-source carrier flow is 8.18E-8 kg/s and corresponding trace injection is 8.18E-6 kg/s.
 4. Acceptance criteria

    ID                Criterion
    AC-01        Maximum room CO2 <= 1000 ppm.
    AC-02          Outdoor concentration remains 300 ppm in baseline run.
    AC-03       ACH command remains within 0.2..6.0 ACH.
    AC-04          physical_supply_m_flow_kg_s = -source_m_flow_command_kg_s.
    AC-05       CO2 source injection equals occupants*8.18E-6 kg/s.
    AC-06          Trend contains 1441 rows including 00:00 and 24:00 endpoints.


 Reference synthetic run summary: maximum room CO2 = 996.524 ppm at t=53999 s. This value is informational evidence
 associated with the supplied trend file.




Synthetic hackathon engineering evidence                                                                    Page 1
